info.name: Amazon Redshift - G E T_ Restore Table from Cluster Snapshot

params.name: ClusterIdentifier
params.description: The identifier of the Amazon Redshift cluster to restore the table to.

params.name: SnapshotIdentifier
params.description: The identifier of the snapshot to restore the table from. This snapshot must have been created from the Amazon Redshift cluster specified by the ClusterIdentifier parameter.

params.name: SourceDatabaseName
params.description: The name of the source database that contains the table to restore from.

params.name: SourceSchemaName
params.description: The name of the source schema that contains the table to restore from. If you do not specify a SourceSchemaName value, the default is public.

params.name: SourceTableName
params.description: The name of the source table to restore from.

params.name: TargetDatabaseName
params.description: The name of the database to restore the table to.

params.name: TargetSchemaName
params.description: The name of the schema to restore the table to.

params.name: NewTableName
params.description: The name of the table to create as a result of the current request.

params.name: EnableCaseSensitiveIdentifier
params.description: Indicates whether name identifiers for database, schema, and table are case sensitive. If true, the names are case sensitive. If false (default), the names are not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Creates a new table from a table in an Amazon Redshift cluster snapshot. You must create the new table within the Amazon Redshift cluster that the snapshot was taken from.

You cannot use RestoreTableFromClusterSnapshot to restore a table with the same name as an existing table in an Amazon Redshift cluster.
